clips.title: QuestSet Player (Beat Saber)
clips.description: Real head motion from one QuestSet player in a fast Beat Saber session, a player the model never trained on. The stretch closest to the session's median head speed.
clips.credit: QuestSet (Baldoni et al., 2024), Research Data Unipd, CC BY 4.0. Changed: head orientation only, converted to the model's frame and resampled to 100 Hz.

clips.title: Synthetic Calm (P25 Speed)
clips.description: Synthetic head turns, dodges and drift at the 25th-percentile head speed of the BOXRR-23 test windows.
clips.credit: Synthetic head motion from the public abc-challenge repo (tools/make_synthetic_data.py). Not a recording of any person.
